🚨 Adin #Licina has undergone surgery to reduce the fracture of his left wrist sustained in the friendly match at the JTC. The intervention took place at the JMedical, as agreed upon between #Cremonese and #Juventus and was perfectly successful. New evaluations after 72h of rest.[IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🇩🇪👀 #Juventus has a clear plan for #Licina: to bring him back to Turin at the end of the season. The simple loan to #Cremonese is designed to allow him to play continuously without pressure. The bianconero club was initially reluctant to let him go, but deemed it more useful to guarantee him a year as a key protagonist and is closely following his progress. The objective is to welcome him back and permanently integrate him into the First Team rotations.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🚨#Juventus João Félix could return to Italy despite his unproductive loan spell at AC Milan. 👀 The 26‑year‑old forward may be available on a free transfer next summer, though his salary remains the main obstacle. Juventus are seen as the most likely destination, with Manchester United and Barcelona also linked.[Ekrem Konur]
